title: Contributors

{{< include _setup.qmd >}}

People with at least one commit that year to any public repo in the
[napari GitHub org](https://github.com/napari). *New* means their first
commit to any of them.

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
show(plots.contributors_by_year(data.contributors_by_year()))
```

## Active contributors

People with a commit in the six months up to each month, and those of them who
have also contributed to a napari plugin's repo.

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
show(plots.active_contributors(data.active_contributors()))
```

## Contributors by release

Each bar is one napari release: its width runs from the previous release to
this one, its height is everyone in the release notes' author list. *New*
means not in any earlier release's list. The last bar is the release in
development. Hover a bar for its numbers.

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
show(plots.release_contributors(data.release_contributors()))
```
